shots.action: [normal] calm push-in on three friends picnicking in a city park, skyline behind; title + real-time countdown
shots.caption: You're having a picnic in Singapore.

shots.action: [xray] the world turns to white edges on black; trees and skyline stream west while the picnic keeps flying east
shots.caption: Earth stops spinning. You don't.

shots.action: [hands] POV: your own wireframe hands; the star-point ground and trees rush toward and under you
shots.caption: The air flies with you, so there's no wind.

shots.action: [glow] the skyline, bolted to the ground, takes the wind: streaks race east and the edges start to glow
shots.caption: But the trees and buildings stop dead.

shots.action: [glow] low angle up the towers: the windows burst into sparkles in a wave from west to east, glow to max
shots.caption: So the air hits them faster than sound.

shots.action: [space] scale jump: the glowing planet in space; the dark Moon slides across in front
shots.caption: Up in orbit, nothing changes at all.

shots.action: [space] low orbit: the bright curved horizon fills the frame, a satellite drifts by untouched
shots.caption: Satellites were never touching the ground.

shots.action: [pointcloud] the park and the friends rebuild as a blue point cloud; streaks shoot up; slow orbit
[blank] near-black beat before the end card
[endcard] end card: the question again + one fact line (loops into frame 0)
